payload.idea: A platform which automates job searching and job applications
payload.focus: Define user personas, key features, and user flow for the automated job searching and application platform.

spec.value_proposition: An automated platform that streamlines job searching and application processes for job seekers by using AI to find, customize, and submit relevant job opportunities efficiently.

personas.name: Emily Johnson
personas.pain_point: Overwhelmed by the volume of job listings and unsure how to tailor applications to different roles.

personas.name: David Kim
personas.pain_point: Lacks time to actively search and apply to new roles due to workload and wants to optimize applications for better response rates.

personas.name: Sarah Patel
personas.pain_point: Needs guidance on how to position skills and experiences for a new industry and struggles with finding relevant job openings.

features.name: Automated Job Matching Engine
features.description: Uses AI to scan thousands of job boards and company postings to identify roles that match user skills, experience, and preferences.

features.name: Resume and Cover Letter Customization
features.description: Automatically tailors resumes and cover letters based on each job description to improve application relevance and success.

features.name: One-Click Application Submission
features.description: Allows users to submit applications directly through the platform to multiple job postings with minimal manual input.

features.name: Applicant Tracking Dashboard
features.description: Provides users with real-time updates on application status, interview invites, and follow-up reminders.

features.name: Skill Gap Analysis & Recommendations
features.description: Analyzes user profiles against desired roles, suggesting courses or certifications to enhance employability in target industries.

user_stories.i_want: to automatically find and apply to jobs that fit my degree and interests
user_stories.so_that: I can efficiently enter the job market without spending hours searching

user_stories.i_want: to have my resume and cover letter customized per job application automatically
user_stories.so_that: my applications stand out without me having to rewrite documents repeatedly

user_stories.i_want: to receive recommendations on how to bridge skill gaps based on my target jobs
user_stories.so_that: I can prepare effectively and increase my chances of hiring success in a new field

email.body:
Hi,

Feeling overwhelmed by endless job listings and tedious applications? Finding the right role while tailoring applications can be time-consuming and stressful.

Our AI-powered platform automatically scans thousands of job boards to find opportunities matching your skills and preferences using the Automated Job Matching Engine. It also customizes your resume and cover letter for each application, increasing your chances of landing interviews. Save hours by automating job discovery and application submissions, increase interview invites with tailored resumes and cover letters, and stay organized with real-time updates and follow-up reminders.

Start your free trial today or learn more on our website.

Best regards,
LaunchMind Team
